item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 15 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #LanaoDelSur(Bumbaran, LumbaBayabao, Maguing), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibuco, Sirawai), #ZamboangaCity, #AgusanDelSur(Sibagat, CityOfBayugan, Prosperidad, Esperanza), #SurigaoDelSur(SanMiguel, Lanuza, Cortes, CityOfTandag, Tago, Bayabas, Cagwait, Marihatag, SanAgustin, Lianga), #AgusanDelNorte(ButuanCity, Buenavista, LasNieves) and #Bukidnon(Talakag) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #Bukidnon(Kalilangan and Pangantucan) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
